newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Chirac says Boeing could be dangerous.
newsitem.headline: Chirac says Boeing could be dangerous.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac, backing the European Commission, said on Wednesday a planned merger between U.S. aerospace giants Boeing and McDonnell Douglas could be dangerous for the European industry.
"We strongly support the Commission on its position on Boeing/McDonnell...it could be extremely dangerous for Europeans," Chirac told a news conference while on an official visit to Belgium.

Separately on Wednesday, a meeting of antitrust experts from the 15 European Union countries recommended unanimously banning the $14 billion merger between Boeing and McDonnell Douglas, an industry source said.
The European Commission is widely expected to follow the advice at its regular meeting next week after Boeing failed to address its concerns that the deal would harm fair competition.
The Commission was not immediately available to comment.
In contrast, the U.S. Federal Trade Commission approved the merger without conditions on July 1.
